verification_report.summary: The entire supplied section is correct under the explicitly granted premises. All statements were checked in textual order, with no critical errors or gaps. Local principalization, divisorial removal from a smoothly corrected closed positive Hessian, and properness give a globally bounded comparison even when the analytic remainder is only bounded. Projection and the ordinary-envelope competitor argument then establish equality and preservation of analytic type. The fixed-local-divisor calculation correctly gives k+A_U(E)>m nu_E(u), with the stated weight convention and discrepancy. Subadditivity and shrinking backgrounds give decreasing envelopes; the common integrable lower bound prevents collapse and proves L1 convergence. The fixed-divisor squeeze, followed by point blowups on local modifications, recovers exactly the data needed to identify the limit with Q_theta[u], without assuming continuity of Q under arbitrary L1 limits. The goodness equivalences and integral criterion follow. Rational scaling gives analytic density in one Hermitian background, preserves decreasing ordinary types, and permits additive renormalization restoring convergence to the original u. The cited comparisons and normalizations match the [final SGPT source](https://mingchenxia.github.io/Lectures/SGPT_final.pdf); local subadditivity matches [Demailly–Ein–Lazarsfeld, Theorem 2.6](https://www.math.stonybrook.edu/~roblaz/Reprints/Demailly.Ein.Laz.Subadditivity.pdf). No BMP, bigness, closedness, mass convergence, smooth-gauge invariance, or unrestricted d_S characterization is imported.
